description: One event by its names: the provider's event, and its action after a dot; what it is about; the sender's delivery ID, which a repeat keeps; when it arrived; and, for an event its declaration gives one, its fact: the text at each of the declaration's pointers into the signed body, never the body.

provider.description: A provider whose events HQ takes, as an admitted module's INBOUND declares it.

about.description: What the fact is about, such as the commit a check ran on.

said_at.description: When the body says the fact was said, in the provider's words.

fact.description: Each value of the fact, by its field.
